title: From Natural Language to Certified Geometry Proofs: A Survey of LLM-Augmented Verification and Neuro-Symbolic Theorem Proving
venue: The Big Picture Workshop at ACL 2026
best_for_zh: 关注几何推理、自动形式化与证明检查的读者。
one_line: A survey of hybrid systems that turn geometry problems into checked proof artifacts.
综述把自然语言与图形几何题转化为可由符号工具或证明助手检查的证明。
why: It helps readers distinguish a convincing geometry explanation from a proof accepted by an explicit verifier.
inclusion_reason: A survey connecting natural-language geometry reasoning to independently checked proof artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Geometry answers can look persuasive while containing an invalid inference, an unstated condition, or a mistaken reading of a diagram. This survey asks how language models and symbolic tools can jointly turn a natural-language geometry problem into a proof artifact that can be independently checked.

For readers, the key distinction is between producing a plausible solution and producing an artifact whose stated checker accepts it. The former can aid exploration; the latter supplies stronger evidence about formal validity. Neither removes the need to verify that the original text and diagram were converted into the intended geometric assumptions.

几何题的答案即使读起来很有说服力，也可能含有无效推理、遗漏条件或误读图形。本综述讨论语言模型如何与符号工具协同，把自然语言几何题变成可独立检查的证明产物。

对读者而言，关键区别是产生看似合理的解答，还是产生能被明确检查器接受的产物。前者可帮助探索，后者为形式有效性提供更强证据。但二者都不能免除对原始文本和图形是否被转换为正确几何假设的检查。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The central idea is to combine a flexible language model with a stricter symbolic backend. The paper organizes the literature by what the model does—parser, strategist, prover, or critic—what proof artifact it emits, and what backend checks it.
核心思路是把灵活的语言模型与严格的符号后端结合。论文按模型承担的角色、产出的证明形式以及负责检查的后端来整理已有系统。

title: Method
方法
html: The surveyed pipeline starts from text and possibly a diagram, converts them into formal constraints, searches for a plan or proof steps, and sends candidate steps to a checker. The reviewed backends include numeric testing, algebraic provers, synthetic provers, and proof-assistant kernels; a failed check can expose what needs repair.
典型流程从题目文本和图形出发，转成形式约束，再搜索解题计划或证明步骤，并把候选步骤交给检查器。综述比较数值测试、代数证明器、综合证明器和证明助手内核，也说明失败的检查如何帮助定位需要修正的环节。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The survey reviews systems including GeoS, Inter-GPS, FormalGeo, AlphaGeometry, and AutoGPS, alongside broader neuro-symbolic approaches. It argues that answer accuracy alone is incomplete evidence: step-level soundness and robustness matter when a system claims to produce a proof.
综述覆盖 GeoS、Inter-GPS、FormalGeo、AlphaGeometry、AutoGPS 等系统，并联系更广义的神经符号方法。论文强调，若系统声称能给出证明，只看最终答案准确率并不够，还要看中间步骤是否可靠、系统是否稳健。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Its contribution is a three-axis vocabulary that lets readers compare heterogeneous geometry systems without reducing them to one score. It separates informal explanations, semi-formal step traces, and kernel-checked proofs, and makes the verification backend a first-class comparison point.
它用三个维度建立比较语言，让读者不必把差异很大的几何系统压成一个分数。论文清楚区分非形式化解释、半形式化步骤轨迹和内核检查证明，并把验证后端作为核心比较对象。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Formalization remains difficult when a diagram is ambiguous or when non-degeneracy conditions are omitted. A symbolic certificate may be rigorous yet hard to teach from, and the survey does not release one shared dataset, model, or experimental protocol.

Checking only establishes validity for the formal statement supplied to the backend. It cannot by itself show that every visual or natural-language assumption was captured correctly, so conversion quality remains part of the evidence.

图形有歧义、非退化条件被遗漏时，形式化仍然很难。符号证书可以严格，却未必便于教学；而且这篇综述不提供统一的数据集、模型或实验协议。

检查只能证明后端收到的形式命题有效，不能自行说明每个图形或自然语言假设都被正确捕获。因此，转换质量也是证据的一部分。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this card when you need to decide what kind of evidence a geometry reasoner should return. It is especially helpful for distinguishing a model that proposes useful steps from a system whose final artifact has been checked by a stated formal mechanism.

It can also guide requirements: specify whether the need is exploration, an explanatory trace, or a checked proof, and identify the mechanism that would establish the requested guarantee.

当你要判断一个几何推理系统应提供哪种证据时，可以阅读这张卡。它特别适合区分“能提出有用步骤”的模型和“最终产物被明确形式机制检查”的系统。

它也可帮助写清需求：究竟需要探索、可解释步骤，还是被检查的证明，并说明哪一种机制能提供所要求的保证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Use the taxonomy as a comparison worksheet. First record the input representation: text alone, a diagram, or both. Next record the formal constraints and the proof artifact, because a natural-language explanation, a semi-formal sequence, and a machine-checked proof make different claims. Finally record the backend and what exactly it checks. This separates a useful proposed construction from a certificate accepted under stated formal rules. It also makes the weak links visible: an ambiguous diagram, a missing condition, a faulty conversion to constraints, or a candidate step that cannot be checked. When a system reports a correct final answer, ask whether that answer was independently checked, whether all steps were checked, and whether the check covers the intended geometric statement. Keep these questions separate from how readable the explanation is. The survey supports this careful comparison of heterogeneous systems; it does not supply one uniform task or score that resolves all of these distinctions.

Read the taxonomy before comparing individual systems. For each system, ask three concrete questions: how is the problem formalized, what proof artifact is produced, and which backend decides whether that artifact is accepted?

Add a fourth question: which part of the result is useful explanation and which part is formally checked evidence? A natural-language plan, a semi-formal trace, and a checked proof can all help a learner, but they make different promises. Trace the pipeline from text or diagram to constraints, candidate steps, and the backend decision. At every transition, note what information might be ambiguous or lost, especially diagram interpretation and unstated non-degeneracy conditions. When comparing systems, keep answer accuracy separate from step validity and from the existence of a checkable final artifact. This makes it possible to value flexible language-model assistance without mistaking it for a guarantee supplied by a symbolic checker.

可把分类当成比较工作表。先记录输入表示是只有文本、只有图形还是二者都有；再记录形式约束和证明产物，因为自然语言解释、半形式化步骤和机器检查证明作出的承诺不同；最后记录后端以及它究竟检查什么。这样可区分有用的候选构造与在明确形式规则下被接受的证书，也能看见薄弱环节：图形歧义、遗漏条件、约束转换错误，或无法检查的候选步骤。当系统报告最终答案正确时，还应问答案是否被独立检查、所有步骤是否被检查、检查是否覆盖目标几何命题，并把这些问题与解释是否易读分开。综述支持这种对异构系统的细致比较，并不提供一套统一任务或单一分数来抹平这些区别。

先读分类框架，再比较具体系统。对每个系统都问三个问题：题目怎样被形式化，产出了什么证明形式，哪个后端决定该产物是否被接受？

还应加问第四个问题：结果中的哪一部分是有用解释，哪一部分是经过形式检查的证据？自然语言计划、半形式化轨迹和被检查的证明都可能帮助学习者，但它们作出的承诺不同。沿着从文本或图形到约束、候选步骤和后端判定的过程追踪，在每次转换处记下可能出现歧义或信息损失的位置，尤其是图形解释和未明说的非退化条件。比较系统时，应把最终答案准确率、步骤有效性和是否存在可检查的最终产物分开。这样既能认可语言模型的灵活辅助，也不会把它误认为符号检查器提供的保证。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Ioannis Tzachristas and Georgios Tzachristas. 2026. From Natural Language to Certified Geometry Proofs: A Survey of LLM-Augmented Verification and Neuro-Symbolic Theorem Proving. Proceedings of The Big Picture Workshop at ACL 2026. https://aclanthology.org/2026.bigpicture-main.1/

The ACL Anthology entry provides the authoritative bibliographic record. For any system-level claim, consult the primary work identified by the survey to see its input representation, formal language, checking backend, and evaluation setting. This survey supplies a comparative vocabulary rather than one common proof benchmark or implementation.

Preserve these details when comparing a claimed proof result with another system.

Ioannis Tzachristas、Georgios Tzachristas，2026。《从自然语言到可认证的几何证明：语言模型增强验证与神经符号定理证明综述》。ACL 2026 Big Picture Workshop。https://aclanthology.org/2026.bigpicture-main.1/

ACL Anthology 页面提供权威书目信息。任何系统层面的主张都应回到综述指出的原始工作，查看输入表示、形式语言、检查后端和评测设置。该综述提供的是比较词汇，不是一套共享证明基准或实现。

比较证明结果时，也应保留这些细节。
